# Getting help

- **How do I…?** Read the [getting started guide](https://github.com/scortes5/agentboard/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md) and the [wiki](https://github.com/scortes5/agentboard/wiki), then ask in [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/scortes5/agentboard/discussions).
- **Something is broken.** Check the [troubleshooting table](https://github.com/scortes5/agentboard/wiki/Troubleshooting), then open a [bug report](https://github.com/scortes5/agentboard/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Security problem.** Follow the [security policy](https://github.com/scortes5/agentboard/security/policy).
